description:
A walk through a sample receipt and invoice matching review for bookkeeping at an invented design studio: matched pairs, and every exception explained for the bookkeeper.

Receipt and Invoice Match Review: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#bookkeeping #receipts

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/receipt-invoice-matching?src=youtube&utm_campaign=receipt-matching-sample-walkthrough
narration: Month-end close stalls on missing receipts and amounts that don't match.
In this sample, nineteen card and bank transactions were checked against nineteen receipts and invoices. Fourteen matched.
The rest are exceptions, each explained. Here, a payment is $14.04 more than its receipt, which may be a tip, so the bookkeeper decides.
Nothing is categorized or changed in your books, and rows that can't be read are listed, never guessed.
